title: Dr Harriet B. Drage
text:
Value-driven leader, open science advocate, fan of fossils.

I am an Assistant Professor at the University of Geneva, working on the palaeobiology and palaeoecology of arthropods in deep time. To do so, I employ sophisticated computational analytical methods, statistics, and fluid dynamics techniques, using big data. I am an advocate of open-access publishing and data, and enjoy dabbling in web design.
I am dedicated to improving publishing, conditions in academia, and inclusivity. I am Co-Founder and Managing Editor of Open Palaeontology (ISSN:), and Newsletter Editor and Charity Trustee for The Palaeontological Association.
I worked previously as a Commissioning Editor for science in secondary education (age 11–18) for Oxford University Press. In my spare time, I enjoy climbing, hiking, weightlifting, video games, and sewing.
